confidence: Moderate on bottle-to-glass route, low to moderate on culprit. Shared stock prevents identifying the glass scrap uniquely as the band.
plausibility_notes: Locked access after 6:28 confines bottle opening to walkthrough or earlier custody, providing useful causal narrowing.
Band appearing intact from front explains why tampering was initially missed without requiring staff to ignore an obvious break.
Matched mixture, individual glass poison, and clean prop are coherent independent clues.
Material similarity is correctly distinguished from a torn-edge match; the stock also serves decoration, retaining real ambiguity.
A fragment inside glass suggests a handling or delivery mechanism but does not by itself establish a person.
Laboratory results arrive quickly for dinner play; this is an acceptable compression, though literal event realism is limited.
